text:
Ava: Morning team — quick proposal for the weekly triage.
Ava: Keep it short: 20m total. Agenda idea:
Ava: 1) Roll-call & blockers (5m)
Ava: 2) Bug queue triage (10m)
Ava: 3) Quick fixes / owner handoffs (5m)
Ava: Move longer design/deep-dive items to an alternate Friday 40m slot.
Ava: Proposed time: Thu 10:30–10:50 (Zoom link in calendar). Pre-reads in this doc: https://redwood.example.com/triage/pre-read
Ava: Quick poll — any hard objections?
Sam: +1 to shorter meetings. My worry: owners might not have quick updates ready. Can we require a 1-line update in the doc before the meeting?
Priya: Agree with Sam. I can keep the pre-read table and add an "owner update" column. :+1:
Diego: Also vote to add a "hotfix lane" label for critical regressions so they jump to top of queue.
Lina: Thursday 10:30 is a bit rough for APAC folks. Can we either alternate with an earlier slot or allow async stubs in the pre-read? :thinking_face:
Ava: Good point. Proposal: keep Thu 10:30 for NA/EU, and we accept async owner notes for APAC. We'll also try the alternate Friday deep-dive at 06:00 PDT once a month for APACs — see poll.
Maya: Calendar event description suggestion (copy into invite):
Maya: ```
Weekly Triage (20m)
Agenda:
- Roll call: 1-liners from owners
- Bug triage: prioritize top 5
- Quick fixes: assign owners for <24h fixes
Pre-reads: add 1-line update to the sheet before meeting
Facilitator: weekly rotation
``` 
Sam: love the facilitator rotation. I'll take next week if no one objects. :hand:
Priya: I'll maintain the pre-read doc and add the owner update column — everyday before the meeting please add 1 line.
Diego: I'll add the "hotfix lane" filter to the triage board and update the runbook with the cutoff criteria.
Lina: I'll create a short APAC-friendly template for async updates to paste into the doc.
ops-bot: Scheduled meeting created: Weekly Triage Thu 10:30–10:50 (recurring). Invite sent to #eng.
Ava: Awesome. Action items:
Ava: - Sam: facilitator next week
Ava: - Priya: pre-read upkeep
Ava: - Diego: hotfix lane + runbook
Ava: - Lina: APAC async template
Ava: We'll trial this format for 4 weeks and reconvene a quick pulse after. Thanks! :rocket:
Sam: 👍 See you next Thu
Priya: will add updates later today
Diego: done — runbook PR inbound
Lina: template in the doc by EOD
Maya: copied the description into the invite
Ava: closing out — marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
